description: Iranian residents found their visas had been revoked before returning to the UAE, preventing re-entry. In multiple cases non-Iranian family members were still allowed to return while the Iranian national was denied.
energy_note: Your family flies home; you do not.

description: Holders of ten-year investment-linked 'golden visas' reported cancellation while abroad. If accurate this is the first reported mass cancellation of golden visas in the programme's history.
energy_note: The visa you bought for permanence, revoked in your absence.

aspect: EXAMPLE - everything is tied to the Emirates ID
description: Lawyers warn property ownership, bank accounts and children's school places are affected, because most such contracts require a valid Emirates ID. A cancelled resident normally has 30 days to exit or amend status after re-entry - but if the visa is voided while they are outside, there is no right to return at all.
energy_note: One document, and the whole life detaches from it.

description: Individuals whose residencies were revoked are reported as being returned to Iran via Afghanistan - transferred to Herat, then crossing by land.
energy_note: Sent home the long way, overland, through a third war.

description: At least five Iranian schools in the UAE were closed, with student records returned to families.
energy_note: Your child's school hands back the file.

description: Iran's judiciary said it had revoked the residency permits of 1,200 UAE citizens living in Iran and ordered them to leave within a week. Ordinary people on both sides became the instrument.

aspect: The banking precedent was already there
description: UAE banks had curbed services for Iranians well before this, with individual salary accounts coming under close scrutiny - so the financial exclusion predates the visa cancellations (see FIN-001).

aspect: SCENARIO - the school that returns the file
description: Reza's cousin has lived in Dubai for nine years. Her residency is cancelled while she is at a wedding in Istanbul. Her two children's school places lapse with the Emirates ID. The school couriers their records to Istanbul with a compliments slip.
energy_note: A family dismantled by an administrative status change.
